date_scope_check.qualification: R4-SC-001-D1: The February 15, 2013 Azattyk report explicitly says Ak-Tash remained closed since January 16, 2013. This contemporary, gate-specific account takes priority over the December 2018 government summary’s conflicting spring-2013 wording; that disagreement remains recorded. December 25, 2018 is a government assertion of resumed resident passage, not independent observation of unrestricted commercial or all-nationality opening. Funerals, celebrations, sickness and emergencies were authorised exceptions in February 2013; agreed supplies continued during 2013–2015. This concerns ordinary direct resident passage, not an absolute seal or unchanging exemptions.
